layers.authority: Local authorities, as reported by Australian Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (Smartraveller)
layers.process: Smartraveller says checkpoints along routes into and out of Transnistria are not official border or immigration points. On entering Transnistria you must complete two copies of a migration card and keep one to show on departure. Entry this way leaves no valid entry stamp in your passport, which can cause problems on leaving Moldova.

laws.rule: Smartraveller says Transnistria uses its own currency, the Transnistrian ruble; Moldovan leu aren't accepted, and banks and services there do not accept foreign credit or debit cards.
